name: Binance
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Cryptocurrency exchange founded by Changpeng Zhao and Yi He, offering crypto trading and, since June 2026, US stocks.
capacity_detail: MGX Fund Management made a minority USD 2bn investment, announced March 2025
sponsorships: Africa Cup of Nations, SS Lazio, FC Porto, Argentina national team (years not stated); Cristiano Ronaldo NFT deal 2022
markets: Worldwide outside restricted markets; licensed in France, Italy, Spain, Sweden, Thailand JV and Abu Dhabi; blocked in EU from May 2026

signals.regions: Permitted to operate in Abu Dhabi (Dec 2025; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Binance)

rationale: World's best-known exchange whose rivals OKX, Crypto.com, Kraken and Gate already use F1 for global brand legitimacy.

name: Bybit
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Dubai-based cryptocurrency exchange founded in 2018 by Ben Zhou, offering spot, derivatives and tokenized products.
capacity_detail: Title sponsor of the ATP 250 Bybit Stockholm Open (2026)
sponsorships: Bybit Stockholm Open title sponsor (2026); Red Bull Racing F1 partner 2022-2024 (ended); Argentina national team 2021; NAVI and Astralis esports 2021
markets: UAE licence, Austria MiCA licence, Bybit Indonesia from 2026, Brazil, Turkey; excluded from US, UK and Singapore

signals.regions: Began operating as Bybit Indonesia after buying OJK-licensed exchange (Jul 2026; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bybit)

rationale: Former Red Bull Racing partner with proven F1 activation experience, now re-entering top-tier sport through ATP tennis.

name: Bitget
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Cryptocurrency exchange led by CEO Gracy Chen that also owns the BitKeep wallet acquired in 2023.
capacity_detail: Multi-year regional partnership with LaLiga signed 2024; LaLiga player ambassadors added Dec 2025
sponsorships: LaLiga regional partner (2024-); MotoGP regional partner for European and Southeast Asian races (2025); Juventus sleeve 2021-23; Messi ambassador 2022-2025
markets: Worldwide customers including UK, El Salvador and EU via Vienna office; withdrawn from Singapore, Hong Kong, Turkey

signals.regions: Opened in Vienna and hired EU chief Oliver Stauber (Jan 2026; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitget)

rationale: Already sponsors LaLiga and MotoGP; F1 is the logical next motorsport step against rivals OKX and Kraken.

name: KuCoin
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Seychelles-registered cryptocurrency exchange serving tens of millions of users in over 200 countries and territories.
capacity_detail: Total funding USD 190M, including a USD 150M Series B at USD 10bn valuation in 2022
sponsorships: Official partner of UAE Team Emirates XRG cycling (Tour de France)
markets: Worldwide in 207 countries and territories; Thailand JV, EU via Austrian MiCA licence, Australia, Nigeria; no US operations

signals.regions: Began EU operations in Austria under MiCA licence (Jan 2026; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/KuCoin)

rationale: Global exchange expanding into regulated EU and Australian markets, needing mass brand trust that F1 rivals already buy.

name: WhiteBIT
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Cryptocurrency exchange founded in 2018, part of W Group, offering over 900 trading pairs and eight fiat currencies.
capacity_detail: Official Cryptocurrency Exchange Partner of FC Barcelona under five-year deal to 2030, signed April 2026
sponsorships: FC Barcelona (2022-2030); Juventus sleeve sponsor 2025-26 to 2027-28; Ukrainian national football team; FACEIT
markets: Europe-focused exchange with over 35 million W Group customers globally; 340 assets and eight fiat currencies
rationale: Big football spender (Barcelona, Juventus) seeking global reach; F1 would extend its sports portfolio beyond football.

name: BYDFi
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Singapore-based cryptocurrency exchange co-founded by CEO Michael Hung, offering digital asset trading to retail users.
capacity_detail: Official Cryptocurrency Exchange Partner of Newcastle United, multi-year deal announced August 2025
sponsorships: Newcastle United official crypto exchange partner (2025-)
markets: Global retail crypto trading platform; Newcastle deal targets the club's international fanbase in key markets
rationale: Premier League sponsor seeking global fan reach; an F1 team deal would broaden visibility beyond English football.

name: Toobit
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Cayman Islands-headquartered cryptocurrency exchange backed by C2 Ventures, HTX Ventures and Mirana Ventures.
capacity_detail: Official Regional Partner of LALIGA for the Middle East and North Africa for the 2025/26 season
sponsorships: LALIGA official regional partner, MENA (Dec 2025 - 2025/26 season)
markets: Global crypto exchange with focus on Middle East and North Africa through its LALIGA regional partnership
rationale: Uses football to win MENA traders; Gulf Grands Prix in Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Abu Dhabi fit its focus.

name: WEEX
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Taipei-based cryptocurrency exchange that is LALIGA's official regional partner for Hong Kong and Taiwan.
capacity_detail: Official Regional Partner of LALIGA in Hong Kong and Taiwan, announced January 2026
sponsorships: LALIGA regional partner Hong Kong and Taiwan (Jan 2026-); LALIGA in-app integration May 2026
markets: Crypto trading for users in Asia, with LALIGA campaigns run for Hong Kong and Taiwan users in 2026
rationale: Asian exchange buying football rights for brand trust; F1 races in Asia offer a comparable regional platform.

name: Bitpanda
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Vienna-based investment platform offering crypto, precious metals, stocks and ETFs to about 4.5 million European customers.
capacity_detail: Raised USD 160M by March 2021 and a further USD 263M in August 2021 at a USD 4.1bn valuation
sponsorships: FC Bayern Munich crypto partner (2024); NFL official partner (2024 season); AC Milan (2024); FC Basel main shirt sponsor (2025-26); Davis Cup (2021)
markets: European Economic Area under its licences; core markets Austria and Germany; offices in ten European cities including London
rationale: Pan-European brand already spending on Bayern, Milan and NFL; F1's European audience matches its EEA customer base.

name: Bithumb
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Seoul-based cryptocurrency exchange owned by Bithumb Holdings, one of South Korea's largest crypto trading platforms.
capacity_detail: Revenue KRW 651.3bn in 2025 (about USD 465M at KRW 1,400)
markets: South Korean retail cryptocurrency traders; headquartered in Gangnam, Seoul

signals.ipo: Announced roadmap targeting IPO in 2028 (Aug 2026; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bithumb)

rationale: Pre-IPO Korean exchange needing brand trust after its 2026 error; F1's Korean fan growth gives a domestic marketing hook.

name: Bitso
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Mexico City-based cryptocurrency exchange serving Mexico, Argentina, Brazil, Colombia and the United States.
capacity_detail: Raised USD 250M Series C in May 2021 at USD 2.2bn valuation
sponsorships: Club Tigres (2021); Mexico national team (2022); Sao Paulo FC (2022)
markets: Mexico, Argentina, Brazil, Colombia and the United States, with local currency trading pairs
rationale: Leading Latin American exchange; Mexico City and Sao Paulo Grands Prix reach its two biggest markets directly.

name: Mercado Bitcoin
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Brazil's largest bitcoin exchange, owned by 2TM Group, serving 2.8 million clients as of 2021.
capacity_detail: Raised USD 200M Series B led by SoftBank Latin America Fund, valuing 2TM at USD 2.1bn
markets: Brazil, with planned expansion to Argentina, Chile, Colombia and Mexico
rationale: Brazil's leading exchange could use the Sao Paulo Grand Prix and F1's Brazilian following to defend share.

name: CoinDCX
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Indian cryptocurrency exchange with over 20 million users and annualized revenue of about USD 141 million.
capacity_detail: Valued at USD 2.45bn post-money in Coinbase investment, October 2025
markets: India, with Coinbase's investment described as expanding presence in India and the Middle East
rationale: Largest Indian exchange by users; F1's growing Indian audience and Middle East races suit its India-Gulf corridor.

name: Blockchain.com
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: London-headquartered crypto wallet and brokerage operating in over 100 countries, with a US headquarters in Dallas.
capacity_detail: Total funding USD 600.5M, including USD 300M at USD 5.2bn valuation in 2021
markets: Over 100 countries, with focus on Nigeria, Ghana, Colombia, Argentina, Turkey, Europe and Singapore; US hub in Dallas
rationale: Pre-IPO brand that previously bought NFL rights; an F1 deal would raise global profile ahead of listing.

name: Polymarket
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: New York-based prediction market where users trade on sports, economic, political and world event outcomes.
capacity_detail: Valued at USD 21bn after USD 1bn round, September 2026
sponsorships: NHL official partner (Oct 2025); MLS exclusive (Jan 2026); New York Rangers (Jan 2026); MLB exclusive (Mar 2026); LaLiga (Apr 2026); UFC partner
markets: Global prediction markets, US under CFTC designation; restricted in Portugal, Brazil, Spain, South Korea, Denmark and others

signals.raise: Raised USD 1bn at USD 21bn valuation (Sep 2026; https://www.caplight.com/lists/crypto)

rationale: Aggressive sports-league buyer (MLB, NHL, MLS, LaLiga, UFC); F1 offers a global motorsport property no prediction market holds.

name: Kalshi
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: New York-based federally regulated exchange offering event contracts on sports, economics, weather and politics.
capacity_detail: Valued at USD 40bn after USD 1bn round, October 2026
sponsorships: NHL official partner (Oct 2025); Chicago Blackhawks (Dec 2025); NBA preferred prediction market partner; CNN, CNBC, Fox News media deals
markets: United States event contracts, restricted in 55 jurisdictions including Brazil, India, Spain and Romania

signals.raise: Raised USD 1bn at USD 40bn valuation (Oct 2026; https://www.caplight.com/lists/crypto)

rationale: Sports drive about 90% of activity; F1's fast-growing US audience and three US races suit its sports-led growth.

name: Novig
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: New York-based sports-only prediction market, designated by the CFTC as a contract market in 2026.
capacity_detail: Exclusive Official Prediction Market Partner of the New York Mets, multiyear deal 2026
sponsorships: New York Mets exclusive prediction market partner (2026); LIV Golf player sleeves at the Masters (Apr 2026)
markets: United States sports prediction market operating nationwide under CFTC designation
rationale: Fast-growing sports prediction market buying team rights; F1's US races give a premium sports property at smaller scale.

name: Ripple
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: San Francisco blockchain payments company offering treasury software, custody, prime brokerage and the RLUSD stablecoin.
capacity_detail: Valued at USD 40bn after USD 500M strategic investment, November 2025
markets: Worldwide customers with offices in 15+ locations; Japan, Spain, India, Switzerland, Singapore and Australia

signals.raise: USD 500M strategic investment led by Fortress, Citadel Securities affiliates and others (Nov 2025; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ripple_Labs)

rationale: Institutional payments brand courting banks globally; F1 hospitality suits B2B relationship building with treasury clients.

name: Tether
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Issuer of the USDT dollar stablecoin, owned by iFinex, with headquarters in El Salvador since 2025.
capacity_detail: Net profit about USD 10bn in 2025 (revenue not published; revenue necessarily exceeds profit)
sponsorships: Minority shareholder in Juventus (2025); rejected bid for Juventus (Dec 2025)
markets: USDT used worldwide; investments across AI, media, robotics and gold; Georgian lari stablecoin announced 2026
rationale: Hugely profitable issuer already investing in elite football; F1 would build mainstream brand trust worldwide.

name: Paxos
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: New York-based issuer of PayPal USD and Pax Gold, providing crypto brokerage and custody for financial firms.
capacity_detail: Total funding USD 535.25M, including USD 300M Series D in April 2021
markets: Enterprise clients in financial services; offices in New York, London and Singapore; partners PayPal, Revolut, OANDA
rationale: B2B stablecoin issuer; F1 hospitality and team tech partnerships could support enterprise sales to banks and fintechs.

name: Anchorage Digital
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Federally chartered US crypto bank providing custody and digital asset services to banks, funds and governments.
capacity_detail: Valued at USD 4.2bn after USD 100M investment from Tether, February 2026
markets: Institutional clients globally; US national trust charter, engineering hub in Porto, office in Singapore
rationale: Institutional brand that could use F1 hospitality to court banks and asset managers; low consumer marketing need.

name: MoonPay
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Miami-based crypto payments company letting users buy and sell crypto, integrated into OpenSea, MetaMask and others.
capacity_detail: First funding round raised USD 555M at USD 3.4bn valuation, November 2021
markets: About 160 countries; New York BitLicense from June 2025; integrated into Coinbase, OpenSea and MetaMask
rationale: Consumer-facing payments brand serving 160 countries; F1 could lift awareness for its consumer app.

name: Consensys
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Ethereum software company behind the MetaMask crypto wallet and Infura blockchain infrastructure.
capacity_detail: Total funding USD 725M, including USD 450M round in March 2022
markets: Global users of MetaMask wallet and Infura; investors include Microsoft, SoftBank and Temasek
rationale: MetaMask is a mass-market wallet brand; F1 exposure could help it compete with exchange wallets that sponsor teams.

name: FalconX
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: San Mateo-based digital asset prime brokerage offering institutional trading, credit and clearing services.
capacity_detail: Total funding USD 427M, including USD 150M Series D in June 2022
markets: Institutional crypto traders and funds; prime brokerage, credit and clearing
rationale: Institutional broker that could use F1 paddock hospitality to court hedge funds and asset managers.

name: Chainalysis
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: New York-based blockchain analytics firm helping governments, banks and brokers trace cryptocurrency transactions.
capacity_detail: Total funding USD 536.6M, including USD 170M in May 2022
markets: Worldwide customers including FBI, DEA, IRS, UK National Crime Agency, banks; regional hub in Dubai
rationale: B2B compliance brand; an F1 technical partnership could showcase data analytics to banks and governments.

name: Erebor Bank
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Columbus-based digital bank offering banking and crypto services to technology, payments, investment and defence businesses.
capacity_detail: Valued at USD 8bn after USD 1.5bn growth equity round, 2026
markets: Businesses and individuals in US technology, payments, investment and defence industries

signals.raise: USD 1.5bn growth equity round at USD 8bn valuation (Jul 2026; https://www.caplight.com/company/erebor-bank)

rationale: Newly capitalised bank targeting tech and defence founders; F1 hospitality fits high-net-worth and corporate client acquisition.

name: Matrixport
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Singapore-based crypto financial services firm offering investing, trading, custody, lending and asset management.
capacity_detail: Total funding USD 158M
markets: Retail and institutional crypto clients, primarily in Asia from Singapore base
rationale: Singapore-based firm; the Singapore Grand Prix gives a natural hospitality platform for wealthy Asian clients.

name: OpenSea
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: New York-based peer-to-peer marketplace where people buy, sell and trade NFTs and other digital collectibles.
capacity_detail: Total funding USD 427.1M, including USD 300M Series C in January 2022
markets: Global online marketplace for NFTs and digital collectibles
rationale: Digital collectibles platform; F1 fan collectibles and team NFTs offer a product-led partnership angle.

name: Dapper Labs
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Vancouver blockchain company building digital collectibles, NFT platforms and games, including NBA Top Shot and Flow.
capacity_detail: Total funding USD 417.86M
sponsorships: NBA Top Shot licensed collectibles partnership (2020-)
markets: Global collectors of NBA Top Shot moments and users of its Flow blockchain
rationale: Proven sports-licensing model with NBA; an F1 collectibles licence would be a natural product extension.

name: Sorare
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: French blockchain fantasy sports game where managers build teams from digital cards of real football, basketball and baseball players.
capacity_detail: Raised USD 680M Series B at USD 4.3bn valuation, September 2021
sponsorships: Licences: LaLiga (2021), MLB (2022), NBA and NBPA (2022), Premier League (2023), Real Madrid
markets: Global fantasy players for football, NBA and MLB; mobile and web; regulatory scrutiny in UK and France
rationale: Licences football, NBA and MLB already; adding F1 driver cards would extend its multi-sport fantasy model.

name: Socios.com
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Malta-based fan engagement platform owned by Chiliz that issues blockchain fan tokens for football clubs.
capacity_detail: Crypto sponsor of six Premier League clubs in the 2025-26 season
sponsorships: Six Premier League clubs (2025-26); FC Barcelona, Paris Saint-Germain, Juventus; UFC fan token (2021); Ballon d'Or (since 2021)
markets: Fans of partner clubs across Europe and worldwide; Premier League, LaLiga, Serie A and Ligue 1 clubs
rationale: Sports fan-token platform; F1 team fan tokens would follow the model it runs with top football clubs.

name: World Liberty Financial
group: Crypto exchanges, digital-asset firms and prediction markets
desc: Crypto venture linked to the Trump family that issues the USD1 stablecoin and the WLFI token.
capacity_detail: Aryam Investment 1 bought a 49% stake for USD 500M in January 2025
sponsorships: Presenting partner of UFC Freedom 250 at the White House (Jun 2026)
markets: USD1 stablecoin used globally, largely held on Binance; agreements in Pakistan; US trust bank approval pending
rationale: Uses marquee sports events for USD1 visibility; politically sensitive, so a team deal carries reputational risk.
